brought_in_and_never_read: 1 column(s) came from outside this campaign and no formula it has measured reads it: `mass_ratio` (https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/doc/periodic_orbits.html). The quantity is already computed, and every form on the record is one edit away from reading it — so this is the cheapest measurement available and the only one that can tell you whether what you went and got is worth anything here. Left unread it is a citation in the write-up and no evidence.

next_batch.generated_from: the levels already measured, crossed — the leading principle's own factors have no unmeasured combination left
notes: the leading principle has been tested on every combination of the factors it names, so it can no longer generate a candidate to tell principles apart: these are the level combinations this campaign has measured least.

measuring evenly BEFORE having a theory is the one thing a campaign cannot go back and do. In a controlled comparison on a real library, evidence chosen evenly gave belief posteriors that were right 67% of the time while asserting 0.77; evidence chosen to maximise the objective was right 23% while asserting 0.76. The arithmetic was the same in both — only the sampling differed.
to get an information-directed batch again, state a principle naming a factor this one does not — the space it can reason about is the space it can propose in.

program_countdown: 2 of the scored candidates carry a `program`. At 5 this stops enumerating and returns a breeding set instead — the best programs so far, the worst for contrast, and the factors on which the two groups differ, which is the material for writing a better one. 3 more to go. These programs carry no `holes`, and that is what keeps proposing on the breeding set: with nothing named inside a program there is no neighbourhood to enumerate, so the record hands back the best and the worst and asks you to write the next one yourself. Naming one hole changes that — a hole is a formula, so its edits are defined, generation varies one hole at a time, and a gain becomes attributable to a component instead of to a whole rewrite. The skeleton is usually something you looked up; the holes are what this campaign is actually searching.
